counterfactual.change: set gravity 9.81 to 0, keeping all else identical; free-flight energy stays constant so no violation, proving excess energy comes from gravity integration

explanation: Fast body triggers ~66-71 substeps per step. Gravity appears applied with full dt per substep instead of dt/substeps, so vertical velocity grows ~substeps times too fast (-3 to -22.6 in 0.33s vs expected -6.27) and mechanical energy grows without controller work, violating energy_bound. Zero-gravity counterfactual with identical motion removes the gain.
vision_note: A blue body drifts slowly leftward across steps 7 to 9, then suddenly drops all the way to the floor in step 10. The single-step vertical plunge is disproportionately large compared to the gradual prior motion.
